name: Machine Learning Engineering
title: Machine Learning Engineer
introduction: Machine Learning Engineers build systems that learn from data and make predictions at scale. They bridge data science research and production software, turning models into reliable products.
whoShouldPursue: Students who enjoy mathematics and coding equally
Those curious about how AI systems work internally
Problem solvers who like optimizing systems

workNature.description: ML engineers spend their day writing code, training models, and deploying them to production while collaborating with data scientists and software teams.

eligibility: B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or related field with strong fundamentals in mathematics
Strong Python programming and understanding of algorithms
Portfolio of ML projects or Kaggle competitions is highly valued

stats.futureOutlook: ML engineering is one of the fastest growing roles in India as every industry adopts AI. Demand far exceeds supply, especially for engineers who can deploy models reliably.

steps.title: Bachelor's Degree
steps.description: B.Tech in Computer Science with focus on mathematics, statistics and programming.

steps.title: Specialisation
steps.description: M.Tech/M.Sc in AI/ML or self-paced specialisation through projects and certifications.

steps.title: Build ML Projects
steps.description: Create 3-5 end-to-end ML projects with deployed demos.

steps.title: Enter Industry
steps.description: Join as data scientist/ML engineer through campus placements or open-source contributions.

conventionalOptions.title: ML Engineer at IT services
conventionalOptions.description: Building ML solutions for enterprise clients.

aiRelatedOptions.title: LLM Application Engineer
aiRelatedOptions.description: Building products on large language models.

seo.title: Machine Learning Engineer Career in India: Salary, Skills & Roadmap
seo.description: Learn how to become a Machine Learning Engineer in India — skills, degrees, salary ranges and career growth in this high-demand AI role.

faqs.question: What does a Machine Learning Engineer do?
faqs.answer: They design, build and deploy machine learning systems that learn from data and make predictions in production applications.

faqs.question: Is coding required for ML engineering?
faqs.answer: Yes — strong Python programming and software engineering fundamentals are essential, alongside mathematics.

env: Office or remote; product and research teams

name: Data Engineering
title: Data Engineer
introduction: Data Engineers build the pipelines and platforms that move and store data reliably at scale. They are the plumbers of the data world — without them, data scientists and analysts have nothing to work with.
whoShouldPursue: Students who like databases and large-scale systems
Those who enjoy coding but prefer infrastructure over interfaces
Detail-oriented problem solvers

workNature.description: Data engineers design data pipelines, manage warehouses, and ensure data quality and availability across organisations.

eligibility: B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or IT
Strong SQL and one programming language (Python/Scala)
Understanding of data structures and distributed systems basics

stats.futureOutlook: As every company becomes data-driven, data engineering demand continues to outpace supply. Cloud data platforms have made this one of the most stable tech careers.

steps.title: Bachelor's Degree
steps.description: B.Tech in Computer Science with database and systems focus.

steps.title: Data Platform Skills
steps.description: Learn Spark, Airflow, cloud data warehouses through projects.

steps.title: Start as Data Analyst
steps.description: Master SQL and reporting first.

steps.title: Move to Pipelines
steps.description: Transition into data engineering by building pipelines.

newAgeOptions.title: Analytics Engineer
newAgeOptions.description: Owning the modelling layer of modern data stacks.

aiRelatedOptions.title: AI Data Platform Engineer
aiRelatedOptions.description: Building data infrastructure for AI systems.

seo.description: Data Engineer career guide for India — skills, education, salary ranges and growth in data infrastructure roles.

faqs.question: What does a Data Engineer do?
faqs.answer: They build and maintain the pipelines and platforms that collect, store and process data for organisations.

faqs.question: Is data engineering harder than data science?
faqs.answer: Different — it focuses more on systems engineering, databases and reliability than statistics.

env: Office or remote; data platform teams

name: Site Reliability Engineering
title: Site Reliability Engineer
introduction: Site Reliability Engineers keep large-scale systems running reliably by applying software engineering to operations. They define reliability targets, automate operations and lead incident response.
whoShouldPursue: Students who enjoy systems and automation
Those calm under pressure
Engineers who like measuring and improving things

workNature.description: SREs split time between writing automation code, monitoring systems and responding to incidents.

eligibility: Understanding of Linux, networking and cloud systems

stats.futureOutlook: As Indian internet scale grows (UPI, e-commerce), SRE demand keeps rising. Companies pay premium for engineers who keep systems reliable.

steps.title: Bachelor's Degree
steps.description: B.Tech Computer Science with systems focus.

steps.title: SRE Skills
steps.description: Learn Kubernetes, observability and incident management through labs.

seo.description: SRE career guide for India — skills, salary, growth path and how to become a Site Reliability Engineer.

faqs.question: What does an SRE do?
faqs.answer: They keep large systems reliable using software engineering — automation, monitoring and incident management.

faqs.question: Is SRE the same as DevOps?
faqs.answer: SRE is Google's specific implementation of DevOps principles with a stronger focus on reliability engineering.

name: Quantum Computing Research
title: Quantum Computing Researcher
introduction: Quantum Computing researchers work on computers that use quantum mechanics to solve problems beyond classical machines. It is a deep research field combining physics, mathematics and computer science.
whoShouldPursue: Students who love physics and mathematics
Those considering research careers
Patient, deep thinkers

workNature.description: Quantum researchers design algorithms, run simulations and publish research, often collaborating with global labs.

eligibility: M.Sc/M.Tech in Physics, Computer Science or Quantum Technology
Strong linear algebra and quantum mechanics foundation
PhD typically required for research leadership

stats.futureOutlook: Quantum computing is 5-10 years from mainstream impact, but governments and companies are investing heavily now. India's National Quantum Mission is creating research positions.

steps.title: Bachelor's Degree
steps.description: B.Sc/B.Tech in Physics or Computer Science with strong mathematics.

steps.title: Masters & PhD
steps.description: M.Sc/M.Tech followed by PhD in quantum computing/quantum information.

aiRelatedOptions.title: Quantum ML Researcher
aiRelatedOptions.description: Combining quantum computing with machine learning.

seo.description: Quantum computing research career guide for India — education path, skills, salary and the National Quantum Mission.

faqs.question: What does a quantum computing researcher do?
faqs.answer: They design quantum algorithms and run experiments on quantum systems to solve problems classical computers cannot.

faqs.question: Do I need a PhD?
faqs.answer: For research leadership, yes — most roles require a PhD in physics, CS or quantum information.
